requirements: Replace prompt-only item creation with visible accessible fields: item name, positive integer unit price, integer quantity 1–99, assignee multi-select. Add edit and remove controls for each item.

Add visible shared-fee rows with name, signed? No: each amount must be non-negative integer VND, add/remove controls and confirmation. Any discount must be modeled as a separately documented adjustment with amount and allowed range, never silently accepted as a negative fee.
Reject, do not coerce, decimals, blank, exponent notation, non-numeric, negative and unsafe amounts. Preserve entered invalid text long enough to show an inline error; do not replace it with 50000.
On participant removal, show and require resolution of affected items before settlement. Disable payment QR until all lines are assigned, totals are conserved and no validation error remains.
Browser test a 3-person scenario with one shared item, two individual items, odd fee, modified quantity, participant removal and every invalid field. Record actual DOM results and conservation.
Start recipient bank/account/name empty in the user-facing app. Do not render QR, payload or payment CTA until explicit confirmation.
Use a confirmation step that displays bank, account string including leading zeros, user-entered display name, selected participant and exact amount. Any edit invalidates confirmation and hides QR.

Keep recipient/payment fields only in RAM; clear on close, explicit reset and reload. Test with synthetic data only. QR payment has status STRUCTURE_VALIDATED; physical bank-app recognition remains NOT_TESTED unless an independent consented device test provides raw evidence.
Add decoder validation for tag lengths and CRC. Do not claim official compatibility from an internal bank list without a cited dated directory source.

For each field intended for display as factual, provide branch_id, field name/value, official or permitted source URL/page, captured artifact path, SHA-256 of that artifact, captured_at, checked_at, expiry/recheck policy and disclosure authorization.
For Wi-Fi, no password value is needed; show guest-access availability only if disclosure is supported. Without the full chain, render 'Chưa có thông tin xác thực' and do not claim availability.

For sockets/AC/parking/bus and payment offers, convert unsupported records to UNKNOWN/NOT_AVAILABLE_FOR_THIS_BRANCH. A DanaBus homepage cannot support a route/stop/time claim. A payment homepage cannot support a discount/cap claim.
Retain existing J372 offer provenance separately. Do not use J373 to upgrade broad wallet, member or student claims. Add a per-card evidence link where evidence exists.

Create a new receipt and candidate manifest after changes; include served hashes, 1440/768/390 screenshots, focus/Escape behavior, 100 real search interactions, DOM arithmetic cases, QR decoder output, storage/network audit, and each factual field count by VERIFIED/UNKNOWN.
Gemini packet must name remaining NOT_TESTED states. Do not mark Gemini PASS.
